title: feat(andline): AND of L1 remaining bits among F_cut line-seed fillers is unique
science: #6404's AND repeated on a second seed: from the 3-site long-axis line {(0,0,0),(1,0,0),(2,0,0)}, N_fill_line=8 and N_and_line=1. The one new fact is seed-independence - the F_cut filler set is the SAME eight maps for the 1-site and the 3-site line seed, though the histories differ ((3,9,12) at T=2 here vs (1,4,8,11,12) at T=4 from the 1-site seed).
